detections.evidence_quote: closing schools for so long was pointless and would cause much worse collateral damage to kids, and they were right
detections.summary: A played clip of a monologue argues pandemic-era mistakes, including prolonged school closures, caused real harm to kids and that people who got it wrong won't admit it.

detections.evidence_quote: there's at least a 50-50 chance that the virus could have begun in the lab in Wuhan that was doing gain-of-function research on that virus
detections.summary: The same clip argues the COVID lab-leak origin theory, once dismissed by media as a conspiracy theory, is now considered plausible by officials.

detections.evidence_quote: when COVID hit, we did a lot of stupid things because America never reacts; it only overreacts
detections.summary: A host says the US overreacted with poor pandemic-era decisions and few retractions have followed.

detections.evidence_quote: all these guys were all pushing the same thing with the with the vaccine and with all the COVID stuff
detections.summary: Hosts argue media figures uniformly pushed the same pro-vaccine/COVID message, are only now walking it back, and should be held accountable for resulting harms including injuries and rising cancer.

detections.evidence_quote: Were you guys getting paid to say it?
detections.summary: A host implies media figures may have been paid to promote pro-vaccine messaging.
